source.description: Reviewed handmade raster felt-tip-marker process contact sheet.
source.notes: One seated cartoon capybara holding one orange; no lettering, labels, arrows, numbers, UI, signatures, watermarks, sticker edge, badge frame, border, extra fruit, or scenery. Six superseded sheets remain private: v1 had an over-complete first panel and unstable dimples; v2 and v3 dropped the left ear; v4 read too much like a bear; v5 dropped the orange anchor; and v6 closed the paws early and used colored construction. The approved seventh sheet corrects those defects.

process_strategy: Eight cumulative panels lock one seated body bean, blunt head box, two forepaw routes, orange footprint, two hind-foot anchors, asymmetric face placements, and shadow before contours, details, ink, or color, then reserve the final panel for reinforcement only.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using one body bean, one blunt head box, two ear ticks, two forepaw routes meeting one orange circle, two hind-foot ovals, three face ticks, and one broken shadow route.

anchor_map.early_mark: One upright body bean joined to one blunt three-quarter head box
anchor_map.becomes: One seated capybara with a broad rump, upright chest, blunt muzzle, and two rounded ears
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The head stays above and slightly left of the body center, the muzzle projects left, and the rump remains planted over the same two hind-foot anchors.
anchor_map.construction_note: Pale primitives only in Panel 1; the body and head silhouettes begin in Panel 2.

anchor_map.early_mark: Exactly two forepaw routes meeting one centered orange circle
anchor_map.becomes: Exactly two short forelegs and two paws holding one orange against the lower chest
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: Both paws touch opposite upper sides of the same orange; the fruit stays centered between chest and hind feet without drifting or multiplying.
anchor_map.construction_note: Routes and one circle only until the forelegs and paws wrap their reserved fruit edges in Panel 3.

anchor_map.early_mark: One wide eye tick, one half-lidded eye tick, one raised-brow tick, and one mouth corner tick
anchor_map.becomes: An asymmetric raised-brow side-eye with one wide oval eye, one half-lidded oval eye, and one crooked closed smile
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The wide eye stays on the left side of the face, the half-lidded eye and raised brow stay on the right, and the smile remains below the blunt nose.
anchor_map.construction_note: Placement ticks only until the expression appears in Panel 4.

final_elements.description: One body bean, one head box, two ear ticks, two forepaw routes, one plain fruit circle, two hind-foot ovals, face ticks, and one broken shadow route.

final_elements.name: seated capybara head body ears and hind feet
final_elements.description: One blunt three-quarter head, one seated body silhouette, exactly two rounded ears, and exactly two visible hind feet.

final_elements.name: two forelegs and paws holding one orange
final_elements.description: Exactly two short forelegs ending in two paws that touch one centered orange.

final_elements.name: asymmetric side-eye nose smile and six whisker dots
final_elements.description: One wide oval eye, one half-lidded oval eye, one raised brow, one blunt nose, one crooked closed smile, and exactly six whisker dots.

final_elements.name: orange leaf fur tufts highlights and broken shadow
final_elements.description: One green leaf on the orange, exactly three distinct fur-tuft groups at the head, cheek, and rump, one open-paper body highlight, one fruit highlight, and one broken navy shadow.

final_elements.name: black marker and complete warm-brown orange teal coral and navy color map
final_elements.description: Thick imperfect black outlines with warm-brown capybara, bright-orange fruit, teal leaf, coral ear and cheek accents, and deep-navy shadow.

final_elements.name: directional marker texture fruit dimples and small contour accents
final_elements.description: Visible marker streaks, established fur direction, exactly four orange dimples, paw accents, highlight edges, and shadow texture.

rejection_checks: Reject a detailed first panel, drifting head angle or seated pose, or an orange that moves, multiplies, or loses either paw contact.
Reject missing or extra capybaras, ears, forepaws, hind feet, oranges, leaves, eyes, brows, whisker dots, fur-tuft groups, highlights, or dimples after those elements appear.
Reject a generic dot-eye U-smile face, symmetrical expression, sticker edge, badge frame, lettering, extra fruit, plants, scenery, or props.
Reject vector-like fills, glossy poster rendering, repeated faint-to-dark tracings, labels, arrows, numbers, text, signatures, or watermarks.
